purpose: Exact qualified tool/interpreter/provider versions and runner requirements measured in this repository (portability T28). Consumed by .github/workflows/portability.yml and tools/ci_portability.py; every entry cites where it was measured.

requirements.mujoco: ==3.12.0 (exact; private error ABI pinned until a deliberate migration)
requirements.env_prefix: uv run --frozen --group native --no-sync; uv lock and unbounded upgrades are forbidden in lanes

linux.observed: CPython 3.13.16 (uv-managed) in the Ubuntu 24.04.5 aarch64 container
linux.note: Python 3.13 is an explicit interpreter requirement, not the unqualified meaning of python3 on Ubuntu 24.04 (system python3 is 3.12); provision it through uv (dev.py bootstrap --python 3.13)

providers.mujoco: 3.12.0 wheel; private ABI symbols _mjPRIVATE_setTlsLogHandler/_mjPRIVATE_getGlobalLogHandler/mj_makeRawData verified by tools/dev.py doctor

Darwin.identity: apple-system dyld-cache image; BLAS 32-bit legacy cblas_*, LAPACK 64-bit *$NEWLAPACK$ILP64

Linux.identity: numpy.libs/libscipy_openblas64_-bb25d554.so inside the NumPy 2.5.2 aarch64 wheel, sha256 5dafca6786e1e366f29ff5e57a6b3beb66a4a02cadf899f51b38fa9fb22c5798; ILP64 (USE64BITINT), scipy_*_64_ spellings

ubuntu-24.04.measured_container: Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS aarch64 on Linux 7.0.14-linuxkit (Docker Desktop linuxkit VM)
ubuntu-24.04.glibc: 2.39-0ubuntu8.9 observed; wheel floor is glibc>=2.28 (pyarrow manylinux_2_28 is the binding constraint)

measured_tools.sdk: MacOSX.sdk default source; xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path -> MacOSX26.5.sdk, version 26.5
measured_tools.analysis_llvm: /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin (keg-only brew LLVM: clang-tidy, analyzer clang++, RTSan clang++)
measured_tools.gxx: Homebrew g++-16 (frontends/odr sweeps require a real GNU frontend)

platforms.unqualified: Linux aarch64 and macOS x86_64 hosted lanes are additional validation lanes only; musl, Windows, cross-compilation and native Wayland are out of scope

analysis_tools_required.note: The native/full profiles run every configured sweep; a missing required tool is a failed gate, never a skip (AGENTS.md/native-engineering.md).

sweep_to_tool.check_tidy: clang-tidy (upstream LLVM; keg-only brew LLVM on macOS)
sweep_to_tool.coverage: llvm-profdata + llvm-cov resolved by tools/native_toolchain.py coverage-tools and qualified by a real instrumented format probe

build: ninja (generator used by the qualified builds)
analysis_tools_required.overrides: CLANG_TIDY, ANALYZER_CLANG, CPPCHECK, GXX, SHELLCHECK, LLVM_PROFDATA, LLVM_COV; invalid explicit overrides are hard errors

sanitizer_lanes.asan: NATIVE_SANITIZE=ON; clang set address,undefined,local-bounds,float-cast-overflow -fno-sanitize-recover=all (GCC keeps the address,undefined core); runtime resolved by compiler identity via tools/native_runtime.py
sanitizer_lanes.rtsan: NATIVE_RTSAN=ON; requires an upstream LLVM clang accepting -fsanitize=realtime (brew LLVM on macOS; LLVM >= 20 on Linux — a distro default that lacks it is an unmet gate, not a skip); ASan+RTSan combination rejected at configure
sanitizer_lanes.coverage: NATIVE_COVERAGE=ON via tools/native_coverage.sh; clang-family only (llvm-cov source-based format); qualified tool pair required

macos-full.note: documented 24-failure macOS baseline is classified by tools/portability_qualification.py (T27), not by this lane runner

macos-release.note: retains the recovered macOS baseline environment as a required release gate

macos-manual-gui.note: retains mjpython/SDK/Accelerate expectations; interactive evidence stays operator-driven

cache_policy: only safe download caches (uv wheels) with keys covering OS/arch/Python/lock hash; compiled native artifacts are never shared between OSes, compiler families, ABI variants or sanitizer modes — each lane reconfigures from source
